display_information.name: beluca.me chat logger
display_information.description: Transcribes beluca.me visitor chat conversations to a private Slack channel.
display_information.long_description: One-way integration for the AI chat on beluca.me. Each completed visitor conversation (in-scope answer, refusal, or fallback) is posted to a private channel via an Incoming Webhook. Phase 1 is one-way only — there is no replying from Slack back to the visitor; that is phase 2.
